question: What rare matter has been asked of Bhairava by the great goddess?
premises: Bhairava expresses approval to the great goddess.
Bhairava states he has been asked.
The matter asked about is hard for gods to obtain.
inference: The great goddess has asked Bhairava about a matter rare even for the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about that which is hard for even the gods to obtain.
